story_text:
Aura NeuroBand is a wearable neurotechnology device that helps you understand and train your mind in real time.
Its EEG sensors read your brain activity and turn it into gentle light and vibration feedback, helping you reduce stress, improve focus and build mental clarity.
We track our steps, our sleep and our heart rate. But the thing running all of it, our mind, usually gets attention only when it's already struggling.
Aura runs quietly in the background of your day. It reads, it responds and, over time, it helps you learn your own patterns.
No audio and no headphones. Aura's haptic engine gives subtle, private cues only you can feel: a gentle hum, a slow breathing pulse or two light taps.
The front light bar shows your state at a glance.
Everything works together. Aura combines brain, heart and motion signals to understand your state more reliably than any one sensor could.
Aura uses dry, gold-plated electrodes, so there's no gel, no prep and nothing to clean off. Before each session, a contact check makes sure every reading is one you can trust.
The Aura app turns complex signals into simple, useful insights, updated live during every session.
Built-in AI pulls everything together, understands your patterns, and coaches you with insights made just for you.
- Live view: your brain activity and heart rate in real time
- Session history: trends, daily logs and streaks
- Insights: AI summaries linking your focus and stress with sleep
- Private by design: encrypted and GDPR-compliant
Aura learns your personal baseline over your first week, so its feedback is shaped by your brain, not an average.
A plastic front module with a removable fabric band that attaches with two poppers. The band comes off in seconds and is machine washable.
The core electronics are sealed and Sweat-resistant, so workouts and warm days aren’t a problem. A wipe is all it needs.
Up to 8 hours per charge, enough to cover your sessions across the day. When it’s time to top up, just plug a USB-C cable into the base.
A soft silicone pad rests comfortably against your forehead, and the fabric band adjusts to fit, then comes off for a wash.
Aura isn't only for athletes or people obsessed with optimisation. It's for the parent rushing around before school, the student trying to concentrate, the busy or neurodiverse mind learning its own patterns, and anyone who wants to understand themselves a little better.
In 2023, I lost my younger brother at 20. As a mother and student myself, grief reshaped how I understood myself.
I became fascinated by the brain and asked: if we can track our steps, sleep and heart rate, why not our mental wellbeing? That question became Aura.
I've spent more than 12 years working in healthcare, I'm studying psychology, and I live with ADHD. I'm not building Aura from a boardroom. I'm building something people like me can use.
Alana Burton, Founder of Aura NeuroBand Ltd, UK
Kickstarter is the beginning of Aura, and we'd love you to build it with us. Thank you for being here.
risks: Aura is a working prototype today. Turning it into a product you can buy is the hard part, so here is what's left. Design for manufacture We finished the final industrial design with Studio Matter in October 2026. Next we build new prototypes on that design and test them with users during the campaign, then prepare for tooling. Anything we learn in testing could move dates. Certification Aura is a Bluetooth wearable with a rechargeable battery. Before it ships it has to pass radio, electrical safety and battery testing for each market: UKCA and CE in the UK and Europe, FCC in the US, ISED in Canada and RCM in Australia. We'll run this testing with an accredited third-party lab after the campaign and post the results in our updates. A failed test. A failed test means a fix and a retest, which can add weeks. Sensors and software The live state view and the light and vibration cues are still in development. Parts and shipping Electronic parts and freight can run late. We will order long-lead parts as soon as the campaign funds. How we'll keep you posted A monthly update with photos and video of real progress. If a date moves, you hear it from us with the reason and the new date.
